When I was younger I had a dog named Bosco. He'd get out of the yard and run off and I'd usually go looking for him.

One day while I was looking for him I met a guy about my age (I was about 8-10 at the time, I think) who helped me look for him. After that we became good friends, even went on to dating when we got older. He was my first kiss.

We'd spend the entire day together. We'd go play in the creek by the park with his siblings, watch tv together, play with wooden swords. I'd go over to his place early in the morning and we'd hang out until the sun was going down.

I ended up moving away (My childhood wasn't so great) but I'd walk several miles to go see him. I didn't see him as often, but it was better than nothing.

One day he moved away. I didn't make it over to see him before he left, didn't get to say goodbye. Didn't have his phone number and now I can't remember his last name.

I've searched and searched on sites like facebook, even checked that dead part of the internet, Myspace. Nothing. There's only so much you can look up with just a first name, vague memory of a face and just the state the person might still be in.

I'd give anything to go back and be there that last day he was there. To go back and get his phone number, hell, just to find him. It's been something like 10+ years now. He may not even remember me. I've forgotten a bit about what he looked like, but I've never forgotten him.
